appearance_facts.fact: Chart title: 'Month vs. Number of cases'
Y-axis label: 'Count', with tick marks at 0, 200, 400, 600, 800, 1000, 1200, 1400
X-axis label: 'Month', with date ticks ranging from 'Jan 27, 2020' to 'Mar 22, 2020', including 'Mar 04, 2020', 'Mar 05, 2020', ..., 'Mar 22, 2020'
A single blue line with circular markers, showing a downward trend from left to right.
The line starts near 0 cases on 'Jan 27, 2020' and remains flat for several days, then begins a steep decline around 'Mar 08, 2020'.
The decline continues through 'Mar 22, 2020', ending at approximately 1400 cases.
The line is plotted against a light blue shaded background area.
